question: Does a small solver-labeled SFT run improve the bounded planner's action execution and intent fit on held-out synthetic scenes?
decision: Keep the baseline until a matched candidate comparison supports a change.
unit: One planner run for one intent on one frozen scene; intents sharing scene geometry are dependent observations.
qualification: First 12 test tasks, two scenes, one occurrence per task and arm. This is qualification, not a claim of general model quality.
fullCampaign: 72 test tasks across 12 held-out scenes; not claimed unless all planned occurrences are recorded.
frozenInputs: frozen/manifest.json contains file hashes, task counts and qualification IDs.
labels: Deterministic family-constrained recipe search and geometry validation, not human cinematic quality ratings.

metrics.success: At least one final validated candidate matches the explicitly requested family, or the model explicitly abstains where the fixed oracle search found no candidate. Numerator successes; denominator available task occurrences.
metrics.geometryValidity: Valid final candidates divided by returned candidates. Model library fallback is not credited.
metrics.schemaValidity: Schema-valid raw model replies divided by all raw replies, including malformed responses before a tool event. Checker v2 adds this raw-reply denominator; the earlier library-only v1 attempt is preserved.
metrics.invalidCandidateRate: Compiled invalid candidates divided by compile actions.
metrics.latency: End-to-end client wall time per task including tool and telemetry work.
metrics.usage: Reported provider prompt and completion token totals. Missing or unreported usage is not a verified zero-dollar cost.

missingness: Infrastructure failures, actor failures and unattempted tasks remain separate. Report available and requested denominators. Stop an arm after two consecutive infrastructure failures.
retryPolicy: One attempt per task. No automatic training POST retries. Unknown training outcomes require job readback before another write.
comparison: Matched before/after requires a real untrained base endpoint and positive trained checkpoint. No invented step-zero adapter.
privacy: Only synthetic fixture text and allowlisted receipts are persisted. API keys remain in the environment and are redacted from exception text.
